events.verdict: Pippen Jr. (MEM) firms up in a screening position in Mitchell's (MIA) path and Mitchell dislodges him from his position during the pick.
Aldama (MEM) never possesses the ball in the frontcourt when he deflects the throw-in and Morant (MEM) legally catches the pass with his foot on the midcourt line.
Adebayo (MIA) legally contests Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) shot attempt in the post.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) and Adebayo (MIA) briefly engage and although their arms get tangled, both players are able to move freely.
Adebayo (MIA) cleanly blocks Morant's (MEM) shot attempt before the ball touches the backboard.
Ware (MIA) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds and Memphis should have been awarded with possession.
Morant (MEM) places his off-arm against Ware (MIA) and stops his forward momentum before he releases from contact and steps back.
Ware (MIA) legally contests Morant's (MEM) jump shot attempt.
After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that Morant (MEM) releases his shot attempt before the expiration of the game clock and the basket is successful.
